claim: Do not change live sprites piece by piece while the game draws; stage patterns and attributes during the render and commit them in one burst at render end.

evidence.text: Tearing and ghosting: sprites were changed piece by piece during the render while the beam was drawing them; fixed by a render-end commit (pieces staged, then pattern OTIR and attributes in one burst), sprites hidden on non-play screens (hardware: smooth, runs).
